text_block_list.text: While out in the city with Shinko Windy, some Umamusume were putting on a mini live show.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! I've missed you so much~!
You're so cute today too! Look over here~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~...! Standing out like that is so unfair, nanoda.
Windy-chan is right here too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot simply stand by and watch.
I must devise a plan—
Mmm, what should I do~?!
Turning toward the voice, I saw Smart Falcon holding her head in distress.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Actually, it seems the girl supposed to perform in the live got caught in traffic, so she's running late~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Even though we promised to make the collab concert between the umamusume idol group and Falco a success...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can't just let it get cancelled like this!
We have to do something... Mmgh...!

It seems like an important live concert for her.
I'd like to do something to help, but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "I knew it was here. With this machine, we can whip up a flashy smoke screen, nod!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! Windy-chan makes her grand entrance there!
Hehehe, that'll grab everyone's attention!

text_block_list.name: Live Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an Umamusume!? Thank goodness,
you made it in time! Now then, please put on this outfit!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm...? Y-Yeah, got it, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Is she mistaking me for someone else?
Well, that actually works out in my favor...!)
(—*hisshhhh...!*)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's that!? Smoke...?
Wait, someone's on stage!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Well, did that startle you?!
The real pranks start nowww!
Just as I was panicking over Shinko Windy's disappearance, she burst onto the stage enveloped in smoke!
choice_data_list: Windy!? Are you playing pranks again...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, could this be... our chance!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Making an energetic entrance is the girl who'll
take a big chomp♪ out of your heart, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To help out that late runner, she jumped right in!
Let's hear some cheers for her, everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? .........Wait? Cheering me on???

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're a stand-in! That smoke effect is really
giving it your all. Good luck out there!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Why are you smiling?!
You guys need to be way more troubled by this!
choice_data_list: Helping people out like that is admirable!
Helping people out like that is admirable, isn't it!
Make the live show flashy and hype up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Why are you smiling?!
You guys need to be way more troubled by this!
choice_data_list: Helping people out like that is admirable!
Helping people out like that is admirable, isn't it!
Make the live show flashy and hype up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"What are you even saying?!
I went through all the trouble of making this grand prank, so be scared~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's so cute how she tries to hide her embarrassment☆ Windy-san is so stubborn~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
L-Like I said...!
You've got it all wroooong!!

Afterward, Shinko Windy's character went over great,
and the concert ended in tremendous success.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: F-Flashily? Liven things up...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for your live, Windy-san!
Eve~ryone's watching you☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!!" earthquakes?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
Heheh, mufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "It can't be helped! If you're going that far, I'll hype things up for you, so you'd better be grateful!"

Afterward, Shinko Windy danced and made a ruckus,
and the live performance was a massive success.
